answer: Because the summit solution is checked at the pigment gate and logged, the crystal audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 28 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. The fee repeats 14 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
